scope: All 23 Gold7 requirements, current pure Rust project; no new public components; performance acceptance remains deferred.
status_policy: Implemented code and deterministic tests do not establish native experience. Missing is never not-applicable. A requirement stays partial until all its child gaps are closed.

repairs.description: Real input/Button shared ROW/COLUMN layout, JSON gap, narrow wrapping, actual Clear action
Standalone action/state-matrix/brand-preview buttons follow BUTTON_CONTENT center; navigation/menu/list leading preserved
JSON 2pt width/2pt offset, neutral ring independent of required/error boundary, actual ancestor clipping
Capture only on successful drag; cancel/rollback/late-event coverage at model/view/adapter
Gallery preference propagation now includes navigation search
Marked composition sampled before blur, matching pointer submit/confirmation blocked; committed later input remains usable
Real Button paint consumes c-button-xs/sm/md/lg-radius; legacy direct painters use md alias without breaking callers
Arrow/Home/End restore a feasible two-pane layout after narrow-mode selection, including clamped endpoints
ComboBox/CommandPalette popup owns wheel events and consumes them before background scrolling; 24-item actual overflow fixtures test Reduced Motion and elastic paths
Real ancestor clips, token focus gutter, full owned control frames, keyboard scroll reveal and Menu/Dialog spacing
JSON Menu/Popover/Dialog elevation reaches actual Gaussian GPU pixels; panels and increased-contrast themes stay shadow-free
Production Button hover/press, Switch thumb and Disclosure body use JSON bindings, interruption and Reduced Motion
Host starts animation requests discovered by the first scene build and stops when completed
Deactivation and late inactive MouseUp clear stale hover/capture/presentation channels

requirements.observation: Warm neutral roles are brand-independent; verify sustained page appearance in four themes.
requirements.next_action: Review long text, normal/disabled text and neutral hierarchy on actual screens.

requirements.observation: Long-form fixture exists, but complete page-by-page spacing/reading review is outstanding.
requirements.next_action: Review every registered page at normal/narrow/150% text; track any layout defects as child tasks.

requirements.observation: Four semantic roles exist; document-canvas intentionally maps surface-1 rather than attachment surface-0.
requirements.next_action: Document the role mapping difference and validate real canvas/region/panel/overlay hierarchy before changing approved background.

requirements.observation: Menu/Popover/Dialog consume JSON two-layer Gaussian elevation through shared production surface paint; panels remain flat and IC has explicit boundaries without shadow.
requirements.next_action: Review physical screen appearance and overlay edge placement; GPU raster checks cover 4 themes at 1x/2x.

requirements.observation: Independent 2pt + 2pt neutral focus ring preserves error/required boundaries; scoped focus gutter and true ancestor clips are implemented.
requirements.next_action: Finish page-by-page physical boundary/focus review without changing required-control contrast.

requirements.observation: Button size aliases are now consumed by production paint; row/column surface radius roles still need semantic audit.

requirements.next_action: Add real concentric fixtures where actually applicable; do not force the rule onto unrelated adjacent shapes.

requirements.observation: Focus paint space and document-space reveal are wired for existing workbench controls; GPU focus/shadow evidence covers 1x/2x; physical display review remains.
requirements.next_action: Audit remaining offscreen roving focus and fractional/physical display edges, without promoting untested experience.

requirements.next_action: Continue per-component coverage including overlay enter/exit lifecycle; do not infer every component is animated.

requirements.observation: Direct tracking exists; SplitView view/adapter cancellation and capture ownership need regression coverage.
requirements.next_action: Close Escape/invalid layout/focus loss cancellation chain; audit explicit lost capture delivery separately.

requirements.observation: Pointer submission can blur/unmark preedit before submit guard observes composition.
